title: rxn-2: apply WP11_LOCK/UNLOCK to all C_* functions touching global state
description: Lock on entry, unlock on every return path in: C_Initialize, C_Finalize, C_GetInfo, C_GetSlotList, C_GetSlotInfo, C_GetTokenInfo, C_GetMechanismList, C_GetMechanismInfo, C_OpenSession, C_CloseSession, C_CloseAllSessions, C_GetSessionInfo, C_Login, C_Logout, C_FindObjectsInit, C_FindObjects, C_FindObjectsFinal, C_GetAttributeValue, C_SignInit, C_Sign, C_VerifyInit, C_Verify, C_DecryptInit, C_Decrypt, C_DestroyObject. Use a goto-cleanup pattern to avoid duplicated unlock on early return.
